items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were just talking about Shelly Manne yesterday. What a wonderful drummer

ctx.x: Did you encounter any of the musicians on the West Coast like Shelly Manne or Conte Candoli or folks like that?

We were just talking about Shelly Manne yesterday. What a wonderful drummer and what an incredible listener. And what a great raconteur, you called me earlier, he sure could get some things together, you know, and then he had his own band there opening for all his favorite bands that he’d bring from the East, it was just great. I really liked him a lot. But the rest of the bands, I remember going to a Bud Shank concert and hearing cool jazz for the first time. And I thought, wow that is cool. I think I like the…
So your period of time in LA like you said, I wasn't sure, but it was a year.
